name: brain-workspace
description: Brain-like project memory and hypothesis tracking for Codex workspaces.

interface.shortDescription: Maintain ideas and tested hypotheses while working.
interface.longDescription: Brain Workspace adds a lightweight Codex operating loop for project memory: ideas stay active until tested, tested hypotheses move into a graveyard with evidence, and relevant memory is refreshed before and after substantive work.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Brain Workspace to work on this project while updating ideas and tested hypotheses.
